en: Lord I want to live my life To please You I bring my heart before You To remold
Make of me a vessel fit for honor That I might shine for You As sparkling gold
To be pleasing You, pleasing You This is all really want to do
Lord I lift my heart in full surrender All that I hold dear I give to You
Purify my heart and make me holy That I might walk the way that's pleasing You
To be pleasing You, pleasing You This is all really want to do
